ideas.title: Backtest gotc discover on the 10 live cities (recall/precision per family)
ideas.why: Discovery found Denver's htyp-tqzh from a cold catalog query; running it blind on all ten hand-built cities gives a measured recall number before we trust it on 40 new metros (SCALING.md §5 #1).

ideas.title: Per-city state files on the pipeline-state branch
ideas.why: Deltas carry every source_record of a shard's cities (1.7 MB gz for NYC+Boston) and CI slim state forces a full rebuild hourly; per-city DBs fix both and keep every file far below GitHub's 100 MB limit (§4.6 item 2).

ideas.title: Week-sharded card files (now.json + w<ISO-week>.json)
ideas.why: gotc validate now warns for Boston, Chicago, NYC and Seattle: their next-14-days cards are 1.7–2.5 MB raw / 259–346 KB gz, over the 1.5 MB / 250 KB first-paint budget (§4.6 item 5).

ideas.title: Coverage UI: Live/Beta chip, pillar strip, coverage matrix page
ideas.why: index.json and every feed now carry coverage (schema 1.5.0) but the dashboard doesn't render it yet, so beta cities look live and thin pillars look like empty lists.

ideas.title: OSM attribution on the dashboard for cached Nominatim coordinates
ideas.why: The OSMF policy requires visible attribution; ~500 cached Nominatim results still place pins even though new lookups are off. Needs 'Geocoding © OpenStreetMap contributors' in the footer/map.

ideas.title: gotc discover --verify: run chosen candidates in a scratch DB
ideas.why: Candidates are scored on one probe; a scratch-DB run per unit (valid/rejected, categories, geofence drops, dup rate vs promoted units) makes promotion a review of numbers, not guesses (§2.8).

ideas.title: Library and university seeds for discover from IMLS PLS + College Scorecard
ideas.why: Seeds are operator-supplied today; the IMLS administrative-entity file and Scorecard (DATA_GOV_API_KEY, ≥10k students, online-only filtered) would make discovery hands-off for metros 11–50.

ideas.title: CivicPlus calendar RSS adapter
ideas.why: CivicPlus hosts city and parks calendars for many suburbs and mid-size cities (metros 30–100); RSSFeed.aspx is robots-allowed with a calendarEvent: namespace. discover already flags it as no_adapter_yet.

ideas.title: Fetch national feeds once per run and share across cities (Challenge, UpcomingCons)
ideas.why: Challenge's 0.9 MB show list is fetched once per city unit today; at 50 cities that's 45 MB/run of identical bodies (§4.6 item 6).

ideas.title: Wikidata venue capacities via www.wikidata.org/w/api.php (wbgetentities)
ideas.why: Considered as the SPARQL replacement.
notes: 2026-10-16 rejected: www.wikidata.org/robots.txt disallows /w/ (so /w/api.php), /api/ and /wiki/Special: for all agents (checked 2026-10-16). Venue capacities come from config/venues instead.

ideas.title: Urban Institute Education Data API (cbsa= filter) for university discovery
ideas.why: Has IPEDS by CBSA in one call.
notes: 2026-10-16 rejected: educationdata.urban.org/robots.txt says Disallow: /api/. Use College Scorecard (api.data.gov key) instead (I-116).

ideas.title: Keep Nominatim at 1 req/s with a per-run cap
ideas.why: Would keep place-name geocoding as before.
notes: 2026-10-16 rejected: nominatim.openstreetmap.org/robots.txt disallows /search and the OSMF policy limits recurring scripts to 4 req/min and strongly discourages periodic app use. Nominatim is off by default; GOTC_NOMINATIM=1 is a compliant 15 s / 20-per-run lane.

ideas.title: Guess Communico tenants from the city name (<name>.libnet.info)
